notes: The standalone code is adapted from the recorded extraction. On 2026-11-08, topology switched to coincident-face unit-normal dot products below zero, removed the extra angle threshold, consolidated position grouping and removed unused private parameters. Fusion supports only paper self-included group-RMS KDE and uniform Mean; obsolete experimental branches and compatibility wrappers were removed. On 2026-11-10, bandwidth scale/floor and Gaussian exponent scale were centralized in SkinningFusionConfig, with optional safe YAML loading and JSON resolved-setting provenance; numerical defaults are unchanged. LBS uses its fixed 3D homogeneous-coordinate convention. Source paths, function lists and hashes below identify the original extraction, not runtime dependencies or byte identity of current adapted modules.
